[[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company's]] '''Arrow-23 landspeeder''' was a fast, agile [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] craft designed for the adventurer set and modified for combat use by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Characteristics==
[[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company's]] Arrow-23 landspeeder was an enclosed [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle,<ref name="AEG" /> measuring 8.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="RASB2" /> It was equipped with military-grade [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and windows that were blast-resistant that could withstand the force of a light [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].<ref name="AEG" /> The exterior was also resistant to animal attack.<ref name="FUCG" /> Fast and comfortable,<ref name="AEG" /> the Arrow-23 could reach speeds of four hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], with a ground clearance of four meters.<ref name="RASB2" />

Standard Arrow-23s required only a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]],<ref name="AEG" /> could carry five passengers,<ref name="RASB" /> had a cargo capacity of eight hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and carried consumables to last a [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="FUCG" /> The craft retailed for between 10,000<ref name="AEG" /> and 10,800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] when bought new,<ref name="RASB2" /> and sold used for anywhere 3,400<ref name="RASB2" /> and 8,000 credits. A high-end luxury model of the Arrow-23 was also produced which contained comfort features including an all-[[Leather/Legends|leather]] interior. These models sold for an extra 10,000 credits over the base price.<ref name="AEG" />

Arrow-23s were regularly modified by their owners;<ref name="AEG" /> the speed and cargo capacity of the landspeeder, along with the ease with which it was modified, were qualities that endeared the craft to [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police forces]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="FUCG" /> Individuals would install additions such as long-range [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], weapon racks, sleeping benches that could fold out of the fuselage, and even manually operated turret weapons.<ref name="AEG" /> If the vehicle was modified to carry weapons, they were manual turrets since the extra power drain to operate the weapon would diminish the vehicle's overall speed.<ref name="RASB" /> Arrow-23s serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were modified by installing<ref name="RASB2" /> a [[Mk 2/S laser cannon]] and a [[Mk 1/S concussion missile launcher]] with a complement of three [[Mk 1/S concussion missile]]s,<ref name="MBC" /> and required a crew of two to operate, a pilot and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="RASB2" />

==History==
The Arrow-23 landspeeder was designed as an adventurer's vehicle, capable of transporting a small party into the wilderness in safety and comfort. The Arrow-23 was popular with a variety of groups, including [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]], tour groups, and campers.<ref name="AEG" /> Arrow-23 landspeeders in service to the Alliance were known as colloquially as "tramp shuttles," a designation that included many modified landspeeders that were intended to enter combat, ferrying [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] to the front line, and delivering [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] and ammunition. Others were converted into makeshift medical facilities, treating and evacuating wounded troops. These vehicles were staffed with a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]].<ref name="RASB" />
